# Grading input source and attribution

[gradeInput.ts](../../src/ui/gradeInput.ts) adapts the horizontal keyboard tweak and formatted numeric-entry rules of Dear ImGui **v1.91.9b**, captured with the desktop target. The exact reference is [imgui_widgets.cpp](../../reference/targets/windows-r0-20261012-02/source/third_party/imgui/imgui_widgets.cpp): `SliderBehaviorT` around lines 3079-3137 and `TempInputScalar` around lines 3640-3670, together with the formatted Escape restoration around lines 4989-5011. The [captured header](../../reference/targets/windows-r0-20261012-02/source/third_party/imgui/imgui.h) records the version.

The adaptation retains display-unit float32 arithmetic, precision-dependent keyboard steps, slow/fast modifiers, the normalized rounding remainder, endpoint handling, and conditional restoration of the initial formatted text. It replaces ImGui activation and global widget state with local React state and browser focus handling. Browser range grab geometry remains a browser adaptation. The decimal parser accepts complete finite text with a recognized display suffix; it rejects unrecognized trailing text, while native `scanf` accepts numeric prefixes.

Dear ImGui is licensed under MIT, copyright (c) 2014-2025 Omar Cornut. The complete [distributed notice](../../public/licenses/ImGui-MIT.txt) is copied without changes from the [captured license](../../reference/targets/windows-r0-20261012-02/source/third_party/imgui/LICENSE.txt). The production manifest includes that notice as a runtime asset. This adaptation introduces no ImGui runtime dependency.

Field order, bounds, units and formatting follow the captured SplatView [color definitions](../../reference/targets/windows-r0-20261012-02/source/src/color.hpp) and [ValueSlider wrapper](../../reference/targets/windows-r0-20261012-02/source/src/ui_widgets.hpp). Pro preset ordering follows the captured [color UI](../../reference/targets/windows-r0-20261012-02/source/src/color_ui.cpp). Native C++/WASM retains scene grading and history ownership. Existing [PlayCanvas references](PLAYCANVAS_REFERENCES.md) and [ImGuizmo attribution](FILTER_GIZMO_REFERENCES.md) remain separate.
